# Desktop Composition


The Desktop Host patch owns product restrictions and optional browser and computer-use providers after the base and web-app bundles load.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  cfg["apps/desktop-host/desktop.patch.yml<br/>cordis.yml"]
  plugin_desktop_browser_use["browser-use<br/>@deepseek-ai/dsh-browser-use"]
  cfg --> plugin_desktop_browser_use
  plugin_desktop_browser_use_chrome_devtools["browser-use-chrome-devtools<br/>@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-browser-use-chrome-devtools-mcp"]
  cfg --> plugin_desktop_browser_use_chrome_devtools
  plugin_desktop_computer_use["computer-use<br/>@deepseek-ai/dsh-computer-use"]
  cfg --> plugin_desktop_computer_use
  plugin_desktop_computer_use_cua_driver["computer-use-cua-driver<br/>@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-computer-use-cua-driver-native"]
  cfg --> plugin_desktop_computer_use_cua_driver
```

| Plugin id | Package / module |
| --- | --- |
| `browser-use` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-browser-use` |
| `browser-use-chrome-devtools` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-browser-use-chrome-devtools-mcp` |
| `computer-use` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-computer-use` |
| `computer-use-cua-driver` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-computer-use-cua-driver-native` |

Source config: [`apps/desktop-host/desktop.patch.yml`](../apps/desktop-host/desktop.patch.yml).

Maintenance mode: hybrid: the patch row list is parsed from its `cordis.yml`; app package expansion is curated from package source.
